csv_project_name: CMAR Service Strom Thurmond Wellness & Fitness Center Renov
csv_scope_of_work: It is the intention of the University of South Carolina to select a Construction Manager at Risk (CM-R) to provide comprehensive pre-construction and construction services for the Strom Thurmond Wellness and Fitness Center Renovation ( Project ). The University of South Carolina seeks a Construction Manager-at-Risk (CM-R) to provide comprehensive preconstruction and construction services for the renovation of the Strom Thurmond Wellness & Fitness Center, including planning, cost estimating, scheduling, value engineering, subcontractor management, GMP development, construction coordination, and project closeout services.

title: CMAR Services for Strom Thurmond Wellness & Fitness Center Renovation
short_description: CMAR services for renovating a university wellness and fitness center in Columbia, South Carolina.
project_location: Columbia, Richland County, South Carolina, USA
project_scope: Renovation of the Strom Thurmond Wellness & Fitness Center at the University of South Carolina. The stated total construction cost is USD 7.0 million to 8.0 million. No gross floor area, structural spans, or detailed technical characteristics are provided in the source.
services: Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) services including preconstruction and construction services, planning, cost estimating, scheduling, value engineering, subcontractor management, GMP development, construction coordination, and project closeout.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a CMAR/procurement for construction management rather than structural design or specialist engineering.
- Building type is a fitness/wellness center renovation, but no long-span, architecturally demanding, or structurally innovative features are described.
- No explicit planning services for structural engineering, bridge engineering, or HOAI-like design phases are requested.
- Could be loosely relevant as a sports-related building, but the notice does not indicate a strategic entry point for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated from the tender documents using the stated total construction cost range of USD 7.0M-8.0M; midpoint used.
fee_explanation: No explicit design or engineering fee for sbp-type services is stated. The notice is for CMAR services only.
